follow-up time: Average of 105 days for newborns with large, round retinal hemorrhage or vitreous hemorrhage
cohort: Preterm newborns admitted to the Department of Ophthalmology, Peking University People's Hospital, Beijing, from January 1, 2016, through August 31, 2021
finding: Preterm newborns with fundus hemorrhage not caused by retinopathy of prematurity were more likely to have superficial, peripheral hemorrhages, and vaginal delivery compression and forceps may be associated with hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not found to be a significant factor in the occurrence of birth-related retinal hemorrhage.
